text: Before youvisitormove to Germany, check if your devices work with German power outlets.

German houses haveType Fpower outlets.1They are also called Schuko or CEE 7/3 sockets. This is the same socket as inmost European countries, and many Asian countries. CEE 7/4 and 7/17 “Shuko” plugwork in German power outlets: CEE 7/16 Europlugsalso work in German power outlets: CEE 7/7 plugs also work in German wall sockets:

Germany has230 Volt, 50 Hzpower sockets. If your country uses the same voltage and frequency, you just need atravel adapter. Plugs, sockets and voltage by country– worldstandards.eu If your country uses a different voltage or frequency, check if your devices support 230V, 50Hz input. This information is always written on the charger. If your charger does not support 230V, 50Hz, you need atravel adapter with a voltage converter. They are bigger and more expensive.
